title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
task: Stabilizing residual stream mixing in multi-stream neural networks
key_results: cmHC reduces hyper-connection latency by 44.8% on Ascend NPUs; proves stream mixing bounds theoretically
comments: Addresses a subtle but important architectural problem—the geometric trade-off between stream independence and coherence—with both theoretical guarantees and practical gains.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Under-mixed matrices near Birkhoff polytope vertices degenerate into independent streams
hypotheses.result: Validated by bounding cumulative residual mixing and stream differences

hypotheses.hypothesis: Over-mixed matrices concentrated at barycenter reduce stream distinguishability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; moderate contraction prevents over-mixing at shallow layers

hypotheses.hypothesis: DiT hidden states encode sufficient information to predict penetration violations
